class.name: OSAppContext
class.brief_description: Everything an OpenDust OS app needs, handed to it when it opens.
class.description: Apps never talk to identity or storage directly; they ask the context for the session and the drive. Apps extending [OSApp] receive it in [code]_setup[/code]; other [Control] scenes receive it through a [code]setup(context)[/code] method if they define one.

method.name: get_device
method.description: The [Device] or [Device2D] the app is running on.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a [code]$SKU[/code] inventory item in its app (placeholder until the inventory registry lands) or a drive path in [code]os.notes[/code].

method.name: notify
method.description: Shows a transient notification in the shell's status bar.
